verdict.delta_sentence: Compared with the nearer intent-classification-2 reference, this board offers stronger sectional grouping but lacks its open corridors, orderly routing, and consistently unobstructed labels.

sub_checks.name: frame_use
sub_checks.note: The main content occupies most of the inner frame, but the lower-left quadrant is conspicuously empty while the upper and right sections are densely packed.

sub_checks.name: corridors_and_air
sub_checks.note: Failure: several chips and labels sit tightly against nodes or wires, with crowded passages around Endpoint allowance, Signed delivery, and Retry & recovery; some node text is visibly truncated.

sub_checks.name: grouping
sub_checks.note: Distinct blue, purple, teal, orange, gray, and green tinted regions clearly separate the five delivery stages, tenant controls, and operations.

sub_checks.name: color
sub_checks.note: Flow families and states use mostly consistent semantic hues, including green completion and red dead-letter treatment, though the many saturated families and mixed dashed outlines create visual noise.

sub_checks.name: machinery_leakage
sub_checks.note: Failure: no crosshair junctions are visible, but several arrows terminate or merge ambiguously near region boundaries, and large dashed routing enclosures read as exposed diagram machinery.

sub_checks.name: alignment_and_rhythm
sub_checks.note: Failure: the five upper stages establish a useful sequence, but irregular box sizing, uneven vertical registers, crowded right-side density, and the detached low operations band weaken the rhythm.

sub_checks.name: edge_legibility
sub_checks.note: Failure: long blue, teal, green, and orange perimeter routes wrap around multiple regions, labels are crossed or crowded by wires, and several merges near Signed delivery and Retry & recovery are difficult to trace.

verdict.rank_order_sanity_note: The assigned scores and visual ordering agree: gc-decomp-harness ranks first, intent-classification-2 second, and the board under grade third.
